summary: Refactored skill and global resource loading: switched SkillEditor to onMount, wrapped it in an editorOpen guard in AgentSettings, replaced the $effect-based resource refresh with onMount, and updated resource discovery to respect PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR with Windows-safe cross-drive handling. Added an `editable` flag to SkillResource, validated that relative paths from workspace are not absolute, and updated README, docs/resources.md, and resource-paths comments to reflect canonical-folder behavior.
decisions: SkillEditor now loads content in onMount rather than as a derived/effect-driven fetch, and is only mounted when editorOpen is true in AgentSettings.
AgentSettings.refreshResources is invoked via onMount instead of a $effect to avoid reassigning state inside an effect.
SkillResource schema gains an optional `editable` boolean indicating Gizmo can safely edit the Markdown in place.
globalResourceRoots and pi-global-resources now honor PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR (with ~ expansion) so a custom Pi agent directory can be used.
Project-vs-global classification now rejects paths that are absolute or start with `..` after relative(), fixing Windows cross-drive misclassification of global resources as project.
Skill index.ts/index.js are accepted as loadable entries alongside .ts/.js files in pi-global-resources.
docs/resources.md and README.md updated to state that Pi's `~/.pi/agent` is the canonical source and that skills and global extensions are toggleable (not just skills).
The legacy migration helper in resource-paths.ts is marked deprecated since canonical discovery no longer copies Pi resources.
errors: svelte-autofixer reported $effect function calls flagged as potentially reassigning stateful variables in AgentSettings/SkillList/SkillEditor; resolve by switching to onMount/derived.
impeccable detect flagged a side-tab accent border and an undocumented color (#4ade80) in apps/app/src/styles/settings.css (process exited 2).
Initial docs/resources.md edit failed due to whitespace mismatch; retried after rg locating exact lines.

pnpm test in apps/app failed: WorkspaceInspector.test.ts and Titlebar.test.ts threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading includes)' on store.activeDomains, plus Titlebar commit-message test error about Pi commit generation.
Final edit to apps/agent-server/src/resources/pi-global-resources.ts failed: 'Could not find edits[0]' due to oldText whitespace mismatch.
